seo.title: Bar 7 Reviews | Upton upon Severn Pub
seo.description: Read customer reviews of Bar 7, a sports bar and pub for drinks, live music and entertainment in Upton upon Severn.

intro.heading: What guests say about Bar 7
intro.text: Customer feedback shared on Google about the drinks, entertainment, live music, sport, and atmosphere at Bar 7.

reviews.author: M Westwood
reviews.text: Wow what a lovely little find on our last full day. Footie, delivered food excellent! Better than neighbouring pubs! Definitely be back and thank you.

reviews.author: D Caine
reviews.text: Billy Idol tribute—fabulous! Great all-round act, this guy is so funny. Had such a laugh and danced most of the night!

reviews.author: A Steggles
reviews.text: Place not my cup of tea. A bit impersonal. Most of the entertainment is not to my liking, but that's personal. Clean and well looked after, bar staff good. They do cheap drink offers on certain nights, including cocktails, which don't interest me. They have door staff on duty.

reviews.author: M Hoxha
reviews.text: I stayed locally for the weekend. Great live music here.

reviews.author: J Allen
reviews.text: Great modernisation has been carried out. Cheap drinks and nice atmosphere. Also, a full-size snooker table!

reviews.author: C Dawe
reviews.text: Beer and lager are excellent and staff friendly. Some great groups and singers on a Saturday night and a beer garden around the back.

reviews.author: P Walker
reviews.text: Great place, friendly staff. Beer garden at rear. Well worth a visit.

reviews.author: S Holmes
reviews.text: Good sports bar but a bit quiet on this occasion.

reviews.author: T Four
reviews.text: Brilliant night, great entertainment. Locals make you welcome. Bring Billy Idol back!

reviews.author: M Holt
reviews.text: Great venue. Great acoustics. Awesome landlord.

reviews.author: J Rolt
reviews.text: It's a social club. Pretty friendly and clean. Worth a look.

reviews.author: J Fernie
reviews.text: Great live music and selection of great drinks.

reviews.author: J Harvey
reviews.text: Always have a good time there. Everyone very friendly.

reviews.author: J Reveley
reviews.text: A cosy place with a useful function room.

reviews.author: C Jones
reviews.text: Best place to go in Upton!

reviews.author: R Johnson
reviews.text: Will let anyone in including rabble.
